_comment: Two interpolation surfaces live in this file. (1) Generator-time: tokens like Treasury are uppercase-snake-case placeholders replaced by `template-manager generate` before the scenario is built — they appear as literal display values at runtime. (2) Runtime: tokens like {{count}} are i18next interpolation, replaced by `t(key, { count })` at render time. Keys that start with an underscore (like this one) are sentinels — skipped by the codegen, parity test, and unused-key audit.

fund.onrampIntro: When the operator runbook is READY, start with USDC you already hold in Coinbase and transfer it to your Base app wallet. If you do not have USDC, buy USDC on Base with an available payment method. Availability varies by region. Coinbase says it charges no Coinbase fee for USDC buys in the Base app, but network or payment-provider costs may apply; use the live preview. New bank-link verification can take 2–5 business days.
fund.onrampBuy: No USDC yet? In the Base app, choose Buy → USDC on Base, enter an amount, select an available payment method, and review the full quote before ordering.
fund.onrampTransfer: Already have USDC in Coinbase? Choose Transfer → Send crypto → USDC → Base, select your Base app wallet, then review the network, amount, and fee.
fund.onrampGas: Keep some ETH on Base in the sending wallet: ERC-20 transfers need ETH for the network fee.
fund.onrampSafety: This local-fork page is for rehearsal. Do not send money to its address or QR code. Fund Treasury only after the operator runbook says READY, and verify the approved network, token, destination, amount, and fee before you confirm.
